intro: Encino stretches along Ventura Boulevard west of the 405, with leafy hillside streets to the south, a long run of restaurants and cafes on the boulevard, and the Sepulveda Basin's parks just to the north.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A friendly coffee bar that also makes rolled ice cream.
places.o: A strawberry matcha or an iced mocha.

places.w: An intimate omakase counter where the chef talks you through every piece. A special-occasion splurge.
places.o: Book the omakase well ahead and arrive on time.

places.w: A classic steak and seafood house, known for prime rib and its holiday decorations.
places.o: Prime rib or a ribeye with a baked potato.

places.w: An upscale kosher dairy restaurant serving fish, Mediterranean plates and sushi.
places.o: A fish main with the sides, and the bread with za'atar butter.

places.w: A small historic park with an 1800s adobe, a spring-fed duck pond and citrus trees.
places.o: Come on the third Sunday of the month for the blacksmith demonstration.
